messages:
nina: Quick post-GA check-in: customers are asking for faster fixes on small regressions + a few UX tweaks. We need a fast decision on scope for the next two-week iteration. Do we prioritize triage-first (bugs) or split upfront?

hugo: From CS: top recurring asks are (a) truncated multi-turn replies in streaming, (b) occasional duplicate messages on retry, (c) confusing rate-limit copy in onboarding. They labeled (a) P0, (b) P1, (c) enhancement.

rachel: Proposed acceptance criteria: P0 = no regression for >50% repro cases after canary; P1 = automated retry with idempotency token; Enhs = copy update + small UX flow in onboarding. Need estimates to slot into sprint.

sam: Engineering estimates: P0 streaming fix = 3 dev-days + 1 day QA + canary; P1 duplicate-retry = 2 dev-days; UX copy + tiny nav = 1 dev-day. If we go bugs-first we can finish P0+P1 in week1+week2 and leave enhs backloged.

nina: My proposal: Week A focus: P0 streaming canary at 5% + hotfix rollback plan, Week B focus: P1 dedupe with idempotency. Enhs groom for next cycle and ship small copy change as hotpatch if safe. Does that match constraints?

hugo: Matches. Customers asking for public comms once we have canary metrics. Please include sample phrasing in the release note.

rachel: I'll write acceptance test list now: `stream_continuity_long_session`, `retry_idempotency_token`, `rate_limit_onboarding_copy`. QA slack will run them on canary traffic.

sam: I'll open work items: INF-2210 (P0 streaming continuity) https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2210, INF-2211 (P1 retry dedupe) https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2211, INF-2212 (onboard copy tiny UX) https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2212. PR incoming for INF-2210 -> branch `fix/inf-2210-streaming-resume`.

dev-bot: Release checklist created: INF-2210 -> canary-5% on 2026-03-27T13:00Z; slack-reminder scheduled 2026-03-27T14:00Z.

hugo: Risk note: streaming repro correlates with certain model variants + long prompt tokens. Recommend routing those sessions to a safer model variant during canary to reduce customer impact.

nina: Good catch. Add routing rule to canary: route model `redwood-chat-xl-v1` long sessions to fallback `redwood-chat-l-compat`. Sam, can you handle that with the routing team?

sam: Yep, will add a temporary route and document in INF-2210. ETA for route change: Tue morning.

rachel: Also flagging telemetry: add a `stream_resume_reason` tag to traces so we can separate network vs runtime resets.

hugo: Customer comms draft: "We're rolling a streaming reliability improvement; we'll monitor canary and follow up with a status update within 24 hours." Put in #customers-template and I'll refine.

nina: OK locking scope: P0 canary (INF-2210) week A, P1 (INF-2211) week B, INF-2212 groomed and small-hotpatchable. Next sync Thurs 9am to review canary metrics and finalize comms. Thanks. :white_check_mark:
